hypotheses.title: Gold Precision Breakout: Four High-Conviction Alphas Targeting EXCELLENT and SPECTACULAR Status
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Engineered with strict mathematical safeguards to eliminate weight concentration and unit errors, while deploying weekly 5-day reversal stabilizers to compress turnover and maximize the Fitness multiplier into the EXCELLENT (>=1.80) and SPECTACULAR (>=2.20) tiers: (1) 1-Year (360d) Call Volatility Term Premium (option8): Evaluates ultra-liquid 1-year institutional call IV against 90-day Parkinson realized volatility, protected by 60d backfill and 5-day reversal. (2) 2-Year (720d) Put Volatility Term Premium (option8): Re-engineers the Sharpe 2.35 put volatility signal with a weekly 5-day reversal, decorrelating below 0.70 and slashing turnover. (3) Subindustry Analyst Consensus Adjusted Net Income Yield (analyst4): Upgrades Alpha 9 (Sharpe 1.74) with a 180-day time-series ranking, quadratic conviction, and 5-day reversal overlay. (4) 3-Year LEAP Call Volatility Term Premium in TOP1000: Deploys the Sharpe 2.42 engine in the liquid large-cap universe to capture pure institutional options flow with low turnover.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if institutional options demand reflects hedging panic rather than informed directional conviction.
